# ResponsiveContainer Rules

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## ResponsiveContainer Rules

This is the most important Recharts lesson from the SpeedBlip build. The ResponsiveContainer component must have a parent element with an explicit height. If it does not, the chart renders with zero height and appears invisible.

The rule: never make ResponsiveContainer the direct child of a flex or grid container.

Here is why it fails silently in flex/grid:

```react
// BROKEN - ResponsiveContainer as direct flex child

...
```

In a flex column with no explicit height on the container, height="100%" resolves to zero. The chart exists in the DOM but has no visible pixels.

The fix - always wrap ResponsiveContainer in a div with an explicit height:

```react
// CORRECT - explicit height wrapper

...
```

This was one of the final fixes in SpeedBlip's build. The chart rendered perfectly in local development (where the dev server was full-page) but appeared as blank sections after a specific layout change in the Dashboard. The fix took two minutes once the root cause was understood.
